Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S05 Unusual phrasing survives Save Note and a reload word for word, both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The stored dictation is identical on reopen: Save Note never rewrites, summarizes or renames the physician's text (issue #39), tested with unusual phrasing. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given The make-session Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident

When Type the odd text into each pre-round box, Save Note, reload the page, reopen the editor

Then The box shows exactly what was typed: misspelling 'furosamide' not corrected, arrows, '??', abbreviations, the hyphenated name and the patient's words unchanged

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs: every distinctive segment present in the reopened editor (case-insensitive substring). Byte-identical (case, line breaks) needs the runnerGap check (Q9)
